summary: Thursday's session extended the risk-off turn, with tech and semiconductors pacing the slide as the S&P fell sharply and the VIX spiked to nearly double its average. Capital kept rotating out of growth and crypto into Treasuries, gold, and consumer staples, a defensive posture that pushed bonds into Greed territory while equities sank into Fear.
tweet: Tech-led selloff and a VIX spike drove Thursday's flight from stocks and crypto into bonds, gold, and staples.
